--- title: "Risk & Multivariate Uncertainty" description: "Risk-aware decision making with conformal risk control, copula-based multivariate modeling, and joint distribution analysis" date: today format: html: self-contained: true embed-resources: true code-fold: true code-tools: true --- # Risk & Multivariate Uncertainty Point predictions miss the costs of being wrong. This notebook covers: **Part A — Risk-Aware Decisions:** - Four built-in risk functions (inventory, asymmetric, threshold, VaR) - `ConformalRiskControl` for cost-sensitive predictions **Part B — Multivariate Uncertainty:** - Copula families and tail dependence - Auto-selection by BIC - Joint sampling and multivariate forecasting ## Setup ::: {#setup .cell cache='true' execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import polars as pl import numpy as np import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor from uncertainty_flow import ( ConformalRegressor, ConformalRiskControl, coverage_score, winkler_score, asymmetric_loss, inventory_cost, threshold_penalty, financial_var, ) from uncertainty_flow.utils import select_validation_plan ``` ::: # Part A: Risk-Aware Decisions ## Data ::: {#cell-risk-data .cell cache='true' execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} energy = pl.read_parquet("../data/energy_efficiency.parquet") target_col = energy.columns[-1] print(f"Shape: {energy.shape}, Target: {target_col}") energy.head(3) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Shape: (768, 10), Target: y2 ``` ::: ::: {#risk-data .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ::: {#risk-splits .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} plan = select_validation_plan(energy, task_type="tabular", holdout_fraction=0.15, random_state=42) train_val, test_df = plan.outer_split n_calib = len(train_val) * 15 // 85 train_df = train_val[:-n_calib] calib_df = train_val[-n_calib:] print(f"Train: {len(train_df)} | Calib: {len(calib_df)} | Test: {len(test_df)}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Train: 538 | Calib: 115 | Test: 115 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#cell-risk-base-model .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} base = ConformalRegressor( base_model=GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42), auto_tune=False, random_state=42, ) base.fit(train_df, target=target_col) ``` ::: {#risk-base-model .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` ``` ::: ::: ## Risk Functions `ConformalRiskControl` wraps a fitted model and controls **expected risk** (not coverage). It returns a DataFrame with `prediction`, `risk`, and `exceeds_threshold` columns. ### 1. Inventory Cost Stockouts cost $10/unit, holding costs $1/unit: ::: {#cell-inventory-risk .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} risk_inv = ConformalRiskControl( base_model=base, risk_function=inventory_cost(holding_cost=1.0, stockout_cost=10.0), target_risk=5.0, random_state=42, ) risk_inv.fit(calib_df, target=target_col) pred_inv = risk_inv.predict(test_df.drop(target_col)) pred_inv.head() ``` ::: {#inventory-risk .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ::: {#cell-inventory-plot .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} y_true = test_df[target_col].to_numpy() preds = pred_inv["prediction"].to_numpy() risks = pred_inv["risk"].to_numpy() flagged = pred_inv["exceeds_threshold"].to_numpy() n_show = min(100, len(y_true)) fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5)) axes[0].hist(risks, bins=30, alpha=0.7, color="#4C78A8", edgecolor="white") axes[0].axvline(np.mean(risks), color="red", linestyle="--", label=f"Mean: {np.mean(risks):.2f}") axes[0].set_xlabel("Estimated Risk") axes[0].set_ylabel("Count") axes[0].set_title("Risk Distribution (Inventory)") axes[0].legend() axes[1].scatter(range(n_show), preds[:n_show], c=flagged[:n_show].astype(int), cmap="coolwarm", s=15, alpha=0.6) axes[1].scatter(range(n_show), y_true[:n_show], s=6, color="#54A24B", alpha=0.4, label="Actual") axes[1].set_xlabel("Sample") axes[1].set_ylabel("Heating load") axes[1].set_title("Predictions (red = exceeds risk threshold)") axes[1].legend(fontsize=8) plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](04_risk_copulas_files/figure-html/inventory-plot-output-1.png){#inventory-plot width=1334 height=470} ::: ::: ### 2. Asymmetric Loss Underpredictions penalized 3x more than overpredictions: ::: {#asymmetric-risk .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} risk_asym = ConformalRiskControl( base_model=base, risk_function=asymmetric_loss(overprediction_penalty=1.0, underprediction_penalty=3.0), target_risk=5.0, random_state=42, ) risk_asym.fit(calib_df, target=target_col) pred_asym = risk_asym.predict(test_df.drop(target_col)) ``` ::: ::: {#cell-asymmetric-plot .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.python .cell-code} preds_a = pred_asym["prediction"].to_numpy() flagged_a = pred_asym["exceeds_threshold"].to_numpy() residuals = y_true - preds_a fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5)) axes[0].scatter(preds_a[:n_show], y_true[:n_show], s=10, alpha=0.5) max_val = max(preds_a[:n_show].max(), y_true[:n_show].max()) axes[0].plot([0, max_val], [0, max_val], "k--", alpha=0.3) axes[0].set_xlabel("Predicted") axes[0].set_ylabel("Actual") axes[0].set_title("Asymmetric Loss: Predicted vs Actual") colors = ["#E45756" if r > 0 else "#4C78A8" for r in residuals[:n_show]] axes[1].scatter(range(n_show), residuals[:n_show], c=colors, s=8, alpha=0.6) axes[1].axhline(y=0, color="gray", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5) axes[1].set_xlabel("Sample") axes[1].set_ylabel("Residual (positive = underprediction)") axes[1].set_title("Residuals (red = underpredicted, costlier)") plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](04_risk_copulas_files/figure-html/asymmetric-plot-output-1.png){#asymmetric-plot width=1334 height=470} ::: ::: ### 3. Threshold Penalty Errors above 5 units penalized at 10x rate — models catastrophic mispredictions: ::: {#threshold-risk .cell execution_count=9} ``` {.python .cell-code} risk_thresh = ConformalRiskControl( base_model=base, risk_function=threshold_penalty(threshold=5.0, penalty_above=10.0, penalty_below=1.0), target_risk=5.0, random_state=42, ) risk_thresh.fit(calib_df, target=target_col) pred_thresh = risk_thresh.predict(test_df.drop(target_col)) ``` ::: ::: {#cell-threshold-plot .cell execution_count=10} ``` {.python .cell-code} preds_t = pred_thresh["prediction"].to_numpy() errors = np.abs(y_true - preds_t) fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5)) colors = ["#E45756" if e > 5.0 else "#4C78A8" for e in errors[:n_show]] ax.scatter(range(n_show), errors[:n_show], c=colors, s=15, alpha=0.6) ax.axhline(y=5.0, color="red", linestyle="--", alpha=0.7, label="Threshold = 5.0") ax.set_xlabel("Sample") ax.set_ylabel("|Error|") ax.set_title("Threshold Penalty — Errors Above Threshold (red) Get 10x Penalty") ax.legend() plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](04_risk_copulas_files/figure-html/threshold-plot-output-1.png){#threshold-plot width=951 height=470} ::: ::: ### 4. Financial VaR Value-at-Risk style penalty for financial applications: ::: {#var-risk .cell execution_count=11} ``` {.python .cell-code} risk_var = ConformalRiskControl( base_model=base, risk_function=financial_var(var_level=0.95, excess_penalty=10.0), target_risk=5.0, random_state=42, ) risk_var.fit(calib_df, target=target_col) pred_var = risk_var.predict(test_df.drop(target_col)) ``` ::: ::: {#cell-var-plot .cell execution_count=12} ``` {.python .cell-code} risks_v = pred_var["risk"].to_numpy() fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5)) ax.hist(risks_v, bins=30, color="#4C78A8", alpha=0.7, edgecolor="white") ax.axvline(x=np.mean(risks_v), color="red", linestyle="--", label=f"Mean risk: {np.mean(risks_v):.2f}") ax.set_xlabel("Estimated Risk") ax.set_ylabel("Frequency") ax.set_title("VaR Risk Control — Distribution of Risks") ax.legend() plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](04_risk_copulas_files/figure-html/var-plot-output-1.png){#var-plot width=950 height=470} ::: ::: ## Risk Comparison ::: {#risk-comparison .cell execution_count=13} ``` {.python .cell-code} print(f"{'Risk Function':<25s} {'Mean_Risk':>12s} {'Flag_Rate':>12s}") print("-" * 51) for name, p in [ ("Inventory cost", pred_inv), ("Asymmetric loss", pred_asym), ("Threshold penalty", pred_thresh), ("Financial VaR", pred_var), ]: mean_risk = p["risk"].mean() flag_rate = p.filter(pl.col("exceeds_threshold")).height / p.height print(f"{name:<25s} {mean_risk:>12.4f} {flag_rate:>12.1%}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Risk Function Mean_Risk Flag_Rate --------------------------------------------------- Inventory cost 5.4274 33.9% Asymmetric loss 3.3999 0.9% Threshold penalty 2.7451 0.9% Financial VaR 2.7451 0.9% ``` ::: ::: ### Standard Conformal vs Risk Control ::: {#standard-vs-risk .cell execution_count=14} ``` {.python .cell-code} base_pred = base.predict(test_df) base_intervals = base_pred.interval(0.9) base_cov = coverage_score(test_df[target_col], base_intervals["lower"], base_intervals["upper"]) base_width = (base_intervals["upper"] - base_intervals["lower"]).mean() print(f"Standard conformal — Coverage: {base_cov:.4f}, Mean interval width: {base_width:.2f}") print(f"Risk control trades coverage guarantees for cost optimization") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Standard conformal — Coverage: 0.6957, Mean interval width: 4.16 Risk control trades coverage guarantees for cost optimization ``` ::: ::: # Part B: Multivariate Uncertainty ## Copula Fundamentals Copulas model the **dependence structure** between variables separately from their marginal distributions. This enables joint sampling and multivariate prediction intervals. ::: {#cell-copula-setup .cell execution_count=15} ``` {.python .cell-code} from uncertainty_flow.multivariate import ( GaussianCopula, ClaytonCopula, GumbelCopula, FrankCopula, auto_select_copula, ) mv = pl.read_parquet("../data/synthetic_multivariate.parquet") print(f"Shape: {mv.shape}") mv.head(3) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Shape: (5000, 7) ``` ::: ::: {#copula-setup .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=15} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ### Compute Residuals Copulas operate on residuals (differences between targets and their medians): ::: {#copula-residuals .cell execution_count=16} ``` {.python .cell-code} targets_mv = ["y1", "y2", "y3"] y1 = mv["y1"].to_numpy() y2 = mv["y2"].to_numpy() y3 = mv["y3"].to_numpy() residuals = np.column_stack([y1, y2, y3]) print(f"Residuals shape: {residuals.shape}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Residuals shape: (5000, 3) ``` ::: ::: ### Compare Copula Families ::: {#cell-copula-comparison .cell execution_count=17} ``` {.python .cell-code} families = { "Gaussian": GaussianCopula(), "Clayton": ClaytonCopula(), "Gumbel": GumbelCopula(), "Frank": FrankCopula(), } rows = [] for name, cop in families.items(): try: cop.fit(residuals[:, :2]) ll = cop.log_likelihood(residuals[:, :2]) rows.append({ "family": name, "theta": round(cop.theta_, 4), "log_likelihood": round(ll, 2), }) except Exception as e: rows.append({"family": name, "theta": None, "log_likelihood": None}) pl.DataFrame(rows) ``` ::: {#copula-comparison .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=17} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ### Auto-Select Best Copula ::: {#auto-copula .cell execution_count=18} ``` {.python .cell-code} best_family = auto_select_copula(residuals[:, :2]) print(f"BIC-selected copula family: {best_family}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` BIC-selected copula family: frank ``` ::: ::: ### Tail Dependence Visualization ::: {#cell-copula-scatter .cell execution_count=19} ``` {.python .cell-code} n_q = 11 quantile_levels = np.linspace(0.05, 0.95, n_q) fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(10, 10)) copulas = [ (GaussianCopula(), "Gaussian\n(linear dependence)"), (ClaytonCopula(), "Clayton\n(lower tail dependence)"), (GumbelCopula(), "Gumbel\n(upper tail dependence)"), (FrankCopula(), "Frank\n(symmetric dependence)"), ] marginals_2d = np.zeros((1, 2, n_q)) for t in range(2): for qi, q in enumerate(quantile_levels): marginals_2d[0, t, qi] = np.quantile(residuals[:, t], q) for ax, (cop, title) in zip(axes.flat, copulas): try: cop.fit(residuals[:, :2]) samples = cop.sample(marginals_2d, n_samples=500, quantile_levels=quantile_levels, random_state=42) ax.scatter(samples[:, 0], samples[:, 1], s=5, alpha=0.4, color="#4C78A8", label="Copula samples") except Exception: ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "fit failed", ha="center", transform=ax.transAxes) ax.scatter(residuals[:, 0], residuals[:, 1], s=3, alpha=0.15, color="#E45756", label="Original") ax.set_xlabel("y1 residual") ax.set_ylabel("y2 residual") ax.set_title(title) ax.legend(fontsize=7) plt.suptitle("Copula Family Comparison — Joint Samples vs Original Data", fontsize=13) plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](04_risk_copulas_files/figure-html/copula-scatter-output-1.png){#copula-scatter width=950 height=946} ::: ::: ## Joint Sampling ::: {#cell-joint-sampling .cell execution_count=20} ``` {.python .cell-code} copula_gauss = GaussianCopula() copula_gauss.fit(residuals[:, :2]) joint = copula_gauss.sample(marginals_2d, n_samples=2000, quantile_levels=quantile_levels, random_state=42) fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 4)) axes[0].scatter(joint[:, 0], joint[:, 1], s=3, alpha=0.3, color="#4C78A8") axes[0].set_xlabel("y1 residual") axes[0].set_ylabel("y2 residual") axes[0].set_title("Joint Samples (2000)") axes[1].hist(joint[:, 0], bins=40, alpha=0.7, color="#4C78A8", label="Sampled") axes[1].hist(residuals[:, 0], bins=40, alpha=0.4, color="#E45756", label="Original") axes[1].set_title("y1 Marginal") axes[1].legend(fontsize=8) axes[2].hist(joint[:, 1], bins=40, alpha=0.7, color="#4C78A8", label="Sampled") axes[2].hist(residuals[:, 1], bins=40, alpha=0.4, color="#E45756", label="Original") axes[2].set_title("y2 Marginal") axes[2].legend(fontsize=8) plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](04_risk_copulas_files/figure-html/joint-sampling-output-1.png){#joint-sampling width=1430 height=374} ::: ::: ## Multivariate Forecasting ::: {#mv-forecasting .cell execution_count=21} ``` {.python .cell-code} from uncertainty_flow import QuantileForestForecaster feature_cols = [c for c in mv.columns if c not in targets_mv] plan_mv = select_validation_plan(mv, task_type="tabular", holdout_fraction=0.2, random_state=42) train_mv, test_mv = plan_mv.outer_split qf_mv = QuantileForestForecaster(targets=targets_mv, horizon=1, random_state=42) qf_mv.fit(train_mv, target=targets_mv) pred_mv = qf_mv.predict(test_mv) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` /Users/minghao/Desktop/personal/uncertainty_flow/uncertainty_flow/models/quantile_forest.py:240: UncertaintyFlowWarning: Auto-selecting copula for 3D data. Only Gaussian copula supports dimensions > 2. [UF-W006] selected = auto_select_copula(stacked_residuals) ``` ::: ::: ::: {#cell-mv-summary .cell execution_count=22} ``` {.python .cell-code} pred_mv.summary() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` /Users/minghao/Desktop/personal/uncertainty_flow/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/IPython/core/interactiveshell.py:3748: UserWarning: Nearest quantile levels differ significantly from requested: 0.75→0.70. Consider using more quantile levels for accurate summary statistics. exec(code_obj, self.user_global_ns, self.user_ns) ``` ::: ::: {#mv-summary .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=22} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ### Cross-Target Correlation ::: {#cell-cross-correlation .cell execution_count=24} ``` {.python .cell-code} medians = pred_mv.median() if isinstance(medians, pl.DataFrame): corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(medians.to_numpy().T) else: corr_matrix = np.array([[1.0]]) fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5)) im = ax.imshow(corr_matrix, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-1, vmax=1) ax.set_xticks(range(len(targets_mv))) ax.set_yticks(range(len(targets_mv))) ax.set_xticklabels(targets_mv) ax.set_yticklabels(targets_mv) for i in range(len(targets_mv)): for j in range(len(targets_mv)): ax.text(j, i, f"{corr_matrix[i, j]:.2f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12) ax.set_title("Cross-Target Correlation (Predicted Medians)") plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax) plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](04_risk_copulas_files/figure-html/cross-correlation-output-1.png){#cross-correlation width=558 height=477} ::: ::: ## Key Takeaways | Concept | API | |---------|-----| | Risk control | `ConformalRiskControl(base_model, risk_function, target_risk)` | | Inventory cost | `inventory_cost(holding, stockout)` | | Asymmetric loss | `asymmetric_loss(over, under)` | | Threshold penalty | `threshold_penalty(threshold, above, below)` | | Financial VaR | `financial_var(var_level, excess_penalty)` | | Copula fitting | `GaussianCopula().fit(residuals_matrix)` | | Auto-select | `auto_select_copula(residuals_matrix)` → family name string | | Joint sampling | `copula.sample(marginals, n_samples, quantile_levels)` | | Multivariate forecast | `QuantileForestForecaster(targets=[...], horizon=N)` |
